claims.assertion: Swaruu distinguishes environmental pollution and ecosystem destruction from what she calls a climate-change control agenda, denying global warming as commonly described.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Attributed claims; the denial and agenda framing are Swaruu’s.

claims.assertion: Swaruu says climate manipulation cannot create hurricanes from nothing but can intensify or steer existing storms.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She also attributes climate variation to natural cycles and other factors.

claims.assertion: Swaruu alleges the Cabal uses Greta Thunberg to promote carbon credits, taxes, and regulations as population-control measures.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: The source presents this as Swaruu’s allegation.
